 for(let gi=0;gi<S.length;gi++){const n=S[gi],it=[];let y=-1e9,x0=1e9,y0=1e9,x1=-1e9,y1=-1e9;for(let i=0;i<n;i++,k+=5){const x=T[k],yy=T[k+1],ti=T[k+2],v=T[k+3],f=T[k+4]/100;it.push([x,yy,ti,v,f]);if(yy>y)y=yy;x0=Math.min(x0,x-60*f);x1=Math.max(x1,x+110*f);y0=Math.min(y0,yy-150*f);y1=Math.max(y1,yy+105*f)}
  it.sort((a,b)=>a[1]-b[1]);const g={i:gi,k:VEG_D.gk?VEG_D.gk[gi]|0:0,it,y,bx0:x0,by0:y0,bx1:x1,by1:y1,c:null,last:0,mark:-1,ok:true};VEG.G.push(g)}
 vegGrid();VEG.ready=true;setTimeout(()=>{try{(window.requestIdleCallback||(f=>setTimeout(f,0)))(()=>{try{vegGuard()}catch(e){vegErr(e)}},{timeout:8000})}catch(e){}},5000)}catch(e){vegErr(e)}return VEG.ready}   // the guard: once, when the game is idle
function vegGrid(){VEG.grid.clear();const C=VEG.cell;for(const g of VEG.G){for(let X=Math.floor(g.bx0/C);X<=Math.floor(g.bx1/C);X++)for(let Y=Math.floor(g.by0/C);Y<=Math.floor(g.by1/C);Y++){const k=X+','+Y;(VEG.grid.get(k)||VEG.grid.set(k,[]).get(k)).push(g)}}}
// a group's picture at density r: every item's shadow, then the bodies from north to south — only from pictures KIT34 already has (the
// missing ones are asked from K34C, which makes them while the view stands still)
// the density of a group picture: the screen's own (quantized) — so the picture is drawn 1:1; under 1 from the kit's pictures at 1, scaled once here
const VEG_LV=[.3,.4,.5,.6,.75];
function vegLevel(sd){if(sd>=.99)return k34Res(sd);for(const l of VEG_LV)if(l>=sd*.98)return l;return 1}
function vegBuild(g,L,ep){const B=KIT34,r=L>=1?L:1;let ok=true;
 for(const it of g.it){const t=vegType(it[2]),v=vegVar(it[2],it[3]);if(!(B.has(t,v,r,'body',0)&&B.has(t,v,r,'shadow',0))){k34Need(t,v,0,r);ok=false}}
 if(!ok){VEG.n.wait++;return null}
 let x0=1e9,y0=1e9,x1=-1e9,y1=-1e9;const P=[];
 for(const it of g.it){const t=vegType(it[2]),v=vegVar(it[2],it[3]),f=it[4],Bd=B.sprite(t,v,r),b=[it[0]-Bd.ox/r*f,it[1]-Bd.oy/r*f,Bd.cv.width/r*f,Bd.cv.height/r*f];
  P.push([Bd.cv,b]);x0=Math.min(x0,b[0]);y0=Math.min(y0,b[1]);x1=Math.max(x1,b[0]+b[2]);y1=Math.max(y1,b[1]+b[3])}   // the bodies only: the shadows are in the ground tiles (vegPaintL1), under the cars and the people
 x0=Math.floor(x0);y0=Math.floor(y0);const W=Math.max(1,Math.ceil((x1-x0)*L)),H=Math.max(1,Math.ceil((y1-y0)*L));
 const cv=window.document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=W;cv.height=H;const c=cv.getContext('2d');c.setTransform(L,0,0,L,-x0*L,-y0*L);if(L<1)c.imageSmoothingQuality='high';
 for(const q of P){const b=q[1];c.drawImage(q[0],b[0],b[1],b[2],b[3])}
 g.bx0=x0;g.by0=y0;g.bx1=x0+W/L;g.by1=y0+H/L;VEG.bytes+=W*H*4;VEG.n.built++;
 return{cv,x0,y0,w:W/L,h:H/L,r:L,ep,bytes:W*H*4}}
function vegFree(c){if(!c)return;VEG.bytes-=c.bytes;try{c.cv.width=0;c.cv.height=0}catch(e){}}
function vegDrawQ(){const c=this.c;if(VEG.near&&Math.abs(Camera.zoom*dpr-c.r)<.005){const sm=ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled;ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;ctx.drawImage(c.cv,c.x0,c.y0,c.w,c.h);ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=sm}else ctx.drawImage(c.cv,c.x0,c.y0,c.w,c.h)}   // 1:1 (the picture at the screen's density, on whole pixels — the camera's offset is rounded): a copy, no filter
// each frame (inside c34Flush, after K34C): the groups in the view into the 3/4 queue — one drawImage each
function vegFrame(now){if(!VEG.on||!vegInit()||!C34G.live||!window.KIT34||!K34C.ready)return;const t0=performance.now();VEG.frame++;
 try{const sd=Camera.zoom*dpr;if(K34C.far){VEG.n.far++;return}   // the far view: the trees are in the tree tiles (T)
  const tz=typeof wtcZq==='function'?wtcZq(sd):sd,low=tz<VEG.lowZ;   // under 0.75: the yard groups are in the ground tiles (vegQueueShadows) — only the street ones here
  const r=vegLevel(sd),ep=WTC.epoch,hw=viewHW()+30,hh=viewHH()+30,cx=viewCX(),cy=viewCY(),x0=cx-hw,x1=cx+hw,y0=cy-hh,y1=cy+hh+20,C=VEG.cell,Q=C34G.q,fr=VEG.frame;
  let bud=VEG.buildMs;
  for(let X=Math.floor(x0/C);X<=Math.floor(x1/C);X++)for(let Y=Math.floor(y0/C);Y<=Math.floor(y1/C);Y++){const L=VEG.grid.get(X+','+Y);if(!L)continue;
   for(const g of L){if(g.mark===fr||!g.ok||(low&&g.k))continue;g.mark=fr;if(g.bx1<x0||g.bx0>x1||g.by1<y0||g.by0>y1)continue;let c=g.c;
    if(!c||c.r!==r||c.ep!==ep){if(bud>0){const t1=performance.now();let nc=null;try{nc=vegBuild(g,r,ep)}catch(e){vegErr(e)}const d=performance.now()-t1;bud-=d;VEG.n.buildMs+=d;if(nc){vegFree(c);g.c=c=nc}}else VEG.n.stale++}
    if(!c)continue;c.last=fr;if(VEG.q){Q.push({y:g.y,f:vegDrawQ,c});VEG.n.drawn++}}}
  if(VEG.bytes>VEG.budgetMB*1048576)vegEvict();
  if(VEG.pend.size&&K34C.gen!==VEG.pendGen)vegPendCheck()}catch(e){vegErr(e)}
 VEG.n.frames++;VEG.n.ms+=performance.now()-t0}
function vegEvict(){const L=VEG.G.filter(g=>g.c&&g.c.last<VEG.frame-2).sort((a,b)=>a.c.last-b.c.last);for(const g of L){if(VEG.bytes<=VEG.budgetMB*1048576*.8)break;vegFree(g.c);g.c=null;VEG.n.evict++}}
/* ---- the ground tiles: the street furniture (KIT34, low) and the retaining walls and stairs (D‑188) — baked, never per frame ---- */
function vegFurnInit(){if(VEG.F)return VEG.F;const D=VEG_D.f||[],F=[];for(let k=0;k<D.length;k+=4)F.push([D[k],D[k+1],D[k+2],D[k+3]]);VEG.F=F;const C=VEG.cell;
 const Bd=VEG_D.b||[],B=[];for(let k=0;k<Bd.length;k+=5)B.push([Bd[k],Bd[k+1],Bd[k+2],Bd[k+3],Bd[k+4]/100]);VEG.B=B;   // the baked trees, from north to south
 for(const o of B)for(let X=Math.floor((o[0]-70)/C);X<=Math.floor((o[0]+110)/C);X++)for(let Y=Math.floor((o[1]-150)/C);Y<=Math.floor((o[1]+105)/C);Y++){const key=X+','+Y;(VEG.Bgrid.get(key)||VEG.Bgrid.set(key,[]).get(key)).push(o)}
 for(const o of F){const key=Math.floor(o[0]/C)+','+Math.floor(o[1]/C);(VEG.Fgrid.get(key)||VEG.Fgrid.set(key,[]).get(key)).push(o)}
 const W=VEG_D.w||[],WL=[];for(let k=0;k<W.length;k+=7)WL.push(W.slice(k,k+7));VEG.W=WL;return F}
function vegTileScale(){const c=ctx.canvas,V=VIEW_OVR;if(!V||c.width<=2||typeof WTC==='undefined'||WTC.ctxBuilding!==ctx)return 0;return c.width/(2*(V.hw-WTC.margin))}
function vegPaintL1(now){if(!VEG.on||typeof VEG_D==='undefined')return;try{const S=vegTileScale();if(!S)return;vegFurnInit();
  const V=VIEW_OVR,x0=V.cx-V.hw,x1=V.cx+V.hw,y0=V.cy-V.hh,y1=V.cy+V.hh;vegWalls(x0,y0,x1,y1,S);
  if(S<K34C.minS){vegFarTrees(x0,y0,x1,y1);return}if(!window.KIT34||!K34C.ready)return;const r=k34Res(S),C=VEG.cell;
  for(let X=Math.floor(x0/C);X<=Math.floor(x1/C);X++)for(let Y=Math.floor(y0/C);Y<=Math.floor(y1/C);Y++){const L=VEG.Fgrid.get(X+','+Y);if(!L)continue;
   for(const o of L){if(o[0]<x0||o[0]>x1||o[1]<y0||o[1]>y1)continue;const t=VEG_D.fa[o[2]],T=KIT34.types[t];if(!T)continue;const v=(Math.imul(o[0]*73856093^o[1]*19349663,2654435761)>>>0)%(typeof T.v==='number'?T.v:1),q=o[3]&3;
    if(KIT34.has(t,v,r,'body',q)&&KIT34.has(t,v,r,'shadow',q)){KIT34.draw(ctx,o[0],o[1],t,v,r,{q});VEG.n.furnDrawn++}else{k34Need(t,v,q,r);VEG.pend.set(o[0]+','+o[1],o);VEG.n.furnWait++}}}
  vegQueueShadows(x0,y0,x1,y1,r,S);vegBakeTrees(x0,y0,x1,y1,r)}catch(e){vegErr(e)}}
// the shadows of the trees in the 3/4 queue (their bodies are the group pictures): on the ground, in the tile
function vegQueueShadows(x0,y0,x1,y1,r,S){if(!vegInit())return;const C=VEG.cell,B=window.KIT34,mk=++VEG.mk,low=S<VEG.lowZ,BD=[];
 for(let X=Math.floor(x0/C);X<=Math.floor(x1/C);X++)for(let Y=Math.floor(y0/C);Y<=Math.floor(y1/C);Y++){const L=VEG.grid.get(X+','+Y);if(!L)continue;
  for(const g of L){if(g.smk===mk||!g.ok)continue;g.smk=mk;for(const it of g.it){if(it[0]<x0-110||it[0]>x1+70||it[1]<y0-105||it[1]>y1+60)continue;const t=vegType(it[2]),v=vegVar(it[2],it[3]);
   if(B.has(t,v,r,'shadow',0)){ctx.save();ctx.translate(it[0],it[1]);if(it[4]!==1)ctx.scale(it[4],it[4]);B.drawShadow(ctx,0,0,t,v,r);ctx.restore();VEG.n.shadows++}else{k34Need(t,v,0,r);VEG.pend.set('s'+it[0]+','+it[1],[it[0],it[1],-1-it[2],it[3]]);VEG.n.bakeWait++}
   if(low&&g.k)BD.push([it,t,v])}}}
 if(BD.length){BD.sort((a,b)=>a[0][1]-b[0][1]);for(const [it,t,v] of BD){if(!B.has(t,v,r,'body',0))continue;ctx.save();ctx.translate(it[0],it[1]);if(it[4]!==1)ctx.scale(it[4],it[4]);B.drawBody(ctx,0,0,t,v,r);ctx.restore();VEG.n.baked++}}}
// the baked trees of this tile: all the shadows, then the bodies from north to south (VEG_D.b is sorted by y) — only from pictures KIT34 has;
// a missing one is asked from K34C and the tile is built again when it is made (VEG.pend → wtcDirty)
function vegBakeTrees(x0,y0,x1,y1,r){const C=VEG.cell,L=[],seen=new Set(),B=window.KIT34;
 for(let X=Math.floor(x0/C);X<=Math.floor(x1/C);X++)for(let Y=Math.floor(y0/C);Y<=Math.floor(y1/C);Y++){const A=VEG.Bgrid.get(X+','+Y);if(A)for(const o of A)if(!seen.has(o)){seen.add(o);if(!o[5]&&o[0]>x0-110&&o[0]<x1+70&&o[1]>y0-105&&o[1]<y1+150)L.push(o)}}
 if(!L.length)return;L.sort((a,b)=>a[1]-b[1]);const ok=[];
 for(const o of L){const t=vegType(o[2]),v=vegVar(o[2],o[3]);if(B.has(t,v,r,'body',0)&&B.has(t,v,r,'shadow',0))ok.push([o,t,v]);else{k34Need(t,v,0,r);VEG.pend.set('b'+o[0]+','+o[1],[o[0],o[1],-1-o[2],o[3]]);VEG.n.bakeWait++}}
 for(const [o,t,v] of ok){ctx.save();ctx.translate(o[0],o[1]);if(o[4]!==1)ctx.scale(o[4],o[4]);B.drawShadow(ctx,0,0,t,v,r);ctx.restore()}
 for(const [o,t,v] of ok){ctx.save();ctx.translate(o[0],o[1]);if(o[4]!==1)ctx.scale(o[4],o[4]);B.drawBody(ctx,0,0,t,v,r);ctx.restore();VEG.n.baked++}}
// the furniture that waited for its picture: when K34C made new pictures, the tiles under it are built again (wtcDirty)
function vegPendCheck(){VEG.pendGen=K34C.gen;const r=k34Res(Camera.zoom*dpr);let n=0;for(const [k,o] of VEG.pend){let t,v,q=o[3]&3;if(o[2]<0){t=vegType(-1-o[2]);v=vegVar(-1-o[2],o[3]);q=0}else{t=VEG_D.fa[o[2]];const T=KIT34.types[t];v=(Math.imul(o[0]*73856093^o[1]*19349663,2654435761)>>>0)%(typeof T.v==='number'?T.v:1)}
  if(KIT34.has(t,v,r,'body',q)){VEG.pend.delete(k);try{if(o[2]<0)wtcDirty(o[0]-70,o[1]-150,180,255);else wtcDirty(o[0]-30,o[1]-40,60,60)}catch(e){}n++}if(n>=24)break}VEG.n.dirty+=n}
// a retaining wall: the ground line (x0, y0)–(x1, y1), the height h (m), the side of the low ground (s: 1 — to the right of the line's
// direction, −1 — to the left); the face is seen when the low ground is to the south (3/4 from the south); kind 1 — stairs (the width of the line)
function vegWalls(x0,y0,x1,y1,S){const W=VEG.W;if(!W||!W.length)return;const K=.6*10,g=ctx;g.save();g.lineJoin='round';
 try{for(const w of W){const ax=w[0],ay=w[1],bx=w[2],by=w[3];if(Math.max(ax,bx)<x0-40||Math.min(ax,bx)>x1+40||Math.max(ay,by)<y0-40||Math.min(ay,by)>y1+40)continue;
  const h=w[4]/10,kind=w[5],side=w[6]?1:-1,L=Math.hypot(bx-ax,by-ay);if(L<1)continue;const ux=(bx-ax)/L,uy=(by-ay)/L,nx=-uy*side,ny=ux*side,H=h*K;   // n — towards the low ground
  if(kind===1){vegStairs(g,ax,ay,bx,by,ux,uy,nx,ny,h);continue}
  const T=4.2,tx=-nx*T,ty=-ny*T;   // the cap: 0.4 m into the high ground
  if(ny>.3){   // the low ground to the south: the face, from the ground line up to the top (y − K·h), stone courses
   g.fillStyle='#9b927f';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(ax,ay);g.lineTo(bx,by);g.lineTo(bx,by-H);g.lineTo(ax,ay-H);g.closePath();g.fill();
   g.strokeStyle='rgba(60,50,38,.35)';g.lineWidth=.6;g.beginPath();for(let z=2.2;z<H-.5;z+=2.4){g.moveTo(ax,ay-z);g.lineTo(bx,by-z)}for(let s=0,k=0;s<L;s+=5,k++){const px=ax+ux*s,py=ay+uy*s;for(let z=0;z<H;z+=2.4){const o=(Math.floor(z/2.4)%2)*2.5;g.moveTo(px+ux*o,py+uy*o-z);g.lineTo(px+ux*o,py+uy*o-Math.min(H,z+2.4))}}g.stroke();
   g.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.18)';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(ax,ay);g.lineTo(bx,by);g.lineTo(bx+nx*2.5,by+ny*2.5);g.lineTo(ax+nx*2.5,ay+ny*2.5);g.closePath();g.fill()}
  else{   // seen from above or from the side: the stone of the wall (its thickness, 0.3 m, and the drop) and the shadow it casts on the low side
   const d=Math.max(4,H*1.2),st=3.6;g.fillStyle='rgba(28,24,18,.42)';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(ax+nx*st,ay+ny*st);g.lineTo(bx+nx*st,by+ny*st);g.lineTo(bx+nx*(st+d),by+ny*(st+d));g.lineTo(ax+nx*(st+d),ay+ny*(st+d));g.closePath();g.fill();
   g.fillStyle='#8f8673';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(ax,ay);g.lineTo(bx,by);g.lineTo(bx+nx*st,by+ny*st);g.lineTo(ax+nx*st,ay+ny*st);g.closePath();g.fill();
   g.strokeStyle='rgba(55,46,34,.5)';g.lineWidth=.6;g.beginPath();for(let s=2.5;s<L;s+=5){const px=ax+ux*s,py=ay+uy*s;g.moveTo(px,py);g.lineTo(px+nx*st,py+ny*st)}g.stroke()}
  const ty2=ny>.3?-H:0;g.fillStyle='#e2d9c4';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(ax,ay+ty2);g.lineTo(bx,by+ty2);g.lineTo(bx+tx,by+ty+ty2);g.lineTo(ax+tx,ay+ty+ty2);g.closePath();g.fill();
  g.strokeStyle='rgba(70,60,45,.6)';g.lineWidth=.7;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(ax,ay+ty2);g.lineTo(bx,by+ty2);g.moveTo(ax+tx,ay+ty+ty2);g.lineTo(bx+tx,by+ty+ty2);g.stroke();VEG.n.wallsDrawn++}}
 catch(e){vegErr(e)}finally{g.restore()}}
// stairs in a wall opening: from the sidewalk (the low side, n) up into the lot — a tread and a riser per step, the width of the opening
function vegStairs(g,ax,ay,bx,by,ux,uy,nx,ny,h){const K=6,n=Math.max(3,Math.min(8,Math.round(h/.16))),run=2.6,Hs=h*K/n,face=ny>.3;
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const o=i*run,z=(i+1)*Hs*(face?1:0),p0x=ax-nx*o,p0y=ay-ny*o,p1x=bx-nx*o,p1y=by-ny*o;
  if(face){g.fillStyle='#a8a08c';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(p0x,p0y-z+Hs);g.lineTo(p1x,p1y-z+Hs);g.lineTo(p1x,p1y-z);g.lineTo(p0x,p0y-z);g.closePath();g.fill()}
  if(!face){g.strokeStyle='rgba(60,52,40,.7)';g.lineWidth=.8;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(p0x,p0y);g.lineTo(p1x,p1y);g.stroke()}
  g.fillStyle=i%2?'#d8d0bd':'#e9e1cf';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(p0x,p0y-z);g.lineTo(p1x,p1y-z);g.lineTo(p1x-nx*run,p1y-ny*run-z);g.lineTo(p0x-nx*run,p0y-ny*run-z);g.closePath();g.fill()}
 const e=run*n;g.strokeStyle='#6f6a60';g.lineWidth=.7;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(ax,ay);g.lineTo(ax-nx*e,ay-ny*e-(face?h*K:0));g.moveTo(bx,by);g.lineTo(bx-nx*e,by-ny*e-(face?h*K:0));g.stroke()}
/* ---- the far view (the tile's scale under K34C.minS — K34C draws no 3/4 there): all the new trees, small, in the ground tile itself — no tile of
   their own (an empty tree tile is still drawn every frame), and at that distance nothing is behind them ---- */
function vegFarTrees(x0,y0,x1,y1){if(!vegInit())return;try{vegFurnInit();const C=VEG.cell,fr=++VEG.mk,B=window.KIT34,one=(x,y,ti,v0,f)=>{const t=vegType(ti),v=vegVar(ti,v0);if(t.startsWith('sign_'))return;
   if(B&&B.has(t,v,1,'body',0)&&B.has(t,v,1,'shadow',0)){ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);if(f!==1)ctx.scale(f,f);B.draw(ctx,0,0,t,v,1);ctx.restore()}else vegFlat(x,y,t,f)};
  const L=[];for(let X=Math.floor(x0/C);X<=Math.floor(x1/C);X++)for(let Y=Math.floor(y0/C);Y<=Math.floor(y1/C);Y++){const G=VEG.grid.get(X+','+Y);if(G)for(const g of G){if(g.fmk===fr||!g.ok)continue;g.fmk=fr;for(const it of g.it)L.push(it)}
   const A=VEG.Bgrid.get(X+','+Y);if(A)for(const o of A){if(o.fmk===fr||o[5])continue;o.fmk=fr;L.push(o)}}
  L.sort((a,b)=>a[1]-b[1]);for(const it of L)one(it[0],it[1],it[2],it[3],it[4])}catch(e){vegErr(e)}}
function vegFlat(x,y,t,f){const B=window.KIT34,T=B&&B.types[t],R=T?T.w*5*f:18;ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.2)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x+R*.5,y+R*.3,R,R*.6,0,0,6.3);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#3f7d34';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y-R*.9,R,0,6.3);ctx.fill()}
/* ---- the hooks: after the original, never instead of it ---- */
(function(){const k0=k34Frame;k34Frame=function(now){k0(now);vegFrame(now)};
 /* g77ZpParse (054) splits the source of wtcPaintL1 / wtcPaintL2 into calls and evals each one in the game's scope (the tiles in parts while
    the zoom moves): a closure name would not be there. L1 — the original does not split (try{} inside), and the braces here keep it that way.
    No hook in L2 (the tree tiles): in the far view the new trees are in the ground tiles (vegFarTrees) — no tree tile of their own */
 const l1=wtcPaintL1;wtcPaintL1=function(now){l1(now);if(VEG.on){vegPaintL1(now)}};
 })();
/* ---- the guard (D‑605, after a merge): a tree that a road, a crossing or a building took since the drawing — is not drawn; the reason is kept ---- */

  else{const rt=Math.max(0,now-c.ready);T.correct++;T.resp.push(+rt.toFixed(1));const pts=Math.max(40,100-Math.round(rt*4));T.score+=pts;T.done[id]=1;T.log.push({id,t:+now.toFixed(1),r:'ok',rt:+rt.toFixed(1)});pvMsg('✓ '+c.name+' — '+c.cr.id+' (+'+pts+')','ok');
   if(T.correct>=PV.target)return pvFinish(true)}}
 else{if(!safe){if(!T.held[id]){T.held[id]=1;T.holds++;T.score+=10;pvMsg('נכון — '+c.cr.id+' ממתין. '+pvWhy(c,now)+' (+10)','ok')}else pvMsg(c.cr.id+' כבר ממתין.','info')}else pvMsg('עכשיו זה בטוח — התפסנית נעולה. אשר.','info')}
 PV.sel=id;pvRender()}
function pvTick(dt){const m=pvState();if(!m){if(PV.on)pvExit();return}if(!PV.on)pvEnter();pvClamp();
 m.timeRemaining=Math.max(0,m.timeRemaining-dt);const now=pvNow(),T=m.tv;
 for(const c of pvCards(now,T.done))if(now>c.ready+PV.miss-.05){T.done[c.id]=1;T.misses++;T.score-=20;T.log.push({id:c.id,t:+now.toFixed(1),r:'miss'});pvMsg('המפקח אישר במקומך: '+c.name+' — '+c.cr.id+' (‎−20)','err')}
 if(m.timeRemaining<=0)return pvFinish(false);pvRender(true)}
function pvFinish(ok){const m=pvState();if(!m)return;const T=m.tv,avg=T.resp.length?+(T.resp.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/T.resp.length).toFixed(1):null;
 const p=PlayerProfile.worldPersistent.portShifts||(PlayerProfile.worldPersistent.portShifts={runs:0,best:null,last:null});p.runs++;p.last={at:iso(),ok,score:T.score,correct:T.correct,errors:T.errors,misses:T.misses,avg};if(ok&&(p.best==null||T.score>p.best))p.best=T.score;
 PV.sum={ok,score:T.score,correct:T.correct,errors:T.errors,misses:T.misses,holds:T.holds,avg,reward:ok?MISSION_DEFS['M-C6-PORTVIEW'].reward:0};PV.sumT=performance.now();
 pvExit();if(ok)missionComplete();else missionFail('timeout');pvRender()}

function csvcRelease(v){if(!v)return;const ts=v.csvc&&v.csvc.ts;v.csvc=null;v.taxiRoute=null;v.plan=null;v.runKey=null;v.wait=false;v.hop=(v.hop||0)+3;if(ts!=null)v.targetSpeed=ts}
function csvcDispatch(o,hitCar){const C=CITYSVC;let D=C.disp;
 if(D){D.offs.push(o);if(D.ph==='stop')csvcCharge(D,false);return}
 D=C.disp={id:'DP-'+(++C.serial),offs:[o],t0:C.t,ph:'find',car:null,x:o.x,y:o.y,retry:0,tries:0,mt:0,ct:0,rt:0,kt:0,sT:0,still:0,lx:0,ly:0};C.st.dispatched++;

function csvcFind(D){const C=CITYSVC,L=TRAFFIC_CARS.filter(csvcFree).sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-D.x,a.y-D.y)-Math.hypot(b.x-D.x,b.y-D.y));

 D.tries++;D.retry=C.t+3;return false}
function csvcNear(D){const p=csvcPlayer(),v=D.car;return !!v&&Math.hypot(p.x-v.x,p.y-v.y)<CITYSVC.cfg.near}
function csvcArrStat(D){const C=CITYSVC,r=C.t-D.t0;C.st.arrived++;C.st.resp.push(+r.toFixed(1));if(C.st.resp.length>40)C.st.resp.shift();C.st.maxResp=Math.max(C.st.maxResp,r);D.tArr=C.t}
function csvcArrive(D){const C=CITYSVC;if(D.ph==='go'||D.ph==='find')csvcArrStat(D);
 if(csvcNear(D)){D.ph='meet';D.mt=0;D.kt=0;return}
 if(csvcP().wanted>=1&&D.ct<C.cfg.chaseMax)csvcChase(D);else csvcClose(D,'absent')}
function csvcChase(D){const C=CITYSVC;if(D.ph!=='chase'){D.ph='chase';C.st.chases++;csvcLog(D.id+' מרדף');try{toast('מרדף! עצור בצד — הניידת אחריך')}catch(e){}}
 const p=csvcPlayer(),v=D.car;D.rt=0;if(v){if(v.taxiRoute&&v.taxiRoute.hold){v.taxiRoute=null;v.wait=false}if(csvcRoute(v,p.x,p.y,'csvc-chase')){D.tx=p.x;D.ty=p.y}}}
/* the fines of the stop: each open offence — a warning or a fine; paid from the money, and what there is not — a debt (paid at the station, F) */
function csvcCharge(D,chase){const C=CITYSVC,P=csvcP();let sum=0,warns=0;
 for(const o of D.offs){if(o.st!=='open')continue;if(o.warn){o.st='warn';P.warnings++;C.st.warnings++;warns++;continue}
  const amt=Math.round(o.amt*(chase?1+C.cfg.fines.chaseAdd:1));o.amt2=amt;sum+=amt}
 let paidNow=0,toDebt=0;if(sum>0){if(PlayerProfile.money>=sum){PlayerProfile.money-=sum;paidNow=sum;P.paid+=sum;try{recordTransaction('police-fine',-sum,{dispatch:D.id,chase:!!chase})}catch(e){}}else{P.debt+=sum;toDebt=sum}}
 for(const o of D.offs){if(o.st!=='open')continue;o.st=paidNow?'paid':'debt';C.st.fined++;P.fines.push({id:o.id,kind:o.kind,label:o.label,kmh:o.kmh,amt:o.amt2,st:o.st,chase:!!chase,clock:o.clock,x:o.x,y:o.y})}
 if(P.debt>0&&PlayerProfile.money>=P.debt){const d=P.debt;PlayerProfile.money-=d;P.paid+=d;P.debt=0;paidNow+=d;try{recordTransaction('police-debt',-d,{dispatch:D.id})}catch(e){}}
 if(P.fines.length>40)P.fines.splice(0,P.fines.length-40);P.wanted=0;P.wantT=0;
 try{toast(sum||warns?('השוטר: '+(warns&&!sum?'אזהרה — בפעם הבאה קנס':'קנס '+money(sum)+(toDebt?' — נרשם כחוב (שלם בתחנת המשטרה)':' — שולם'))):'השוטר: הכול בסדר — סע בזהירות')}catch(e){}
 }
function csvcClose(D,why){const C=CITYSVC,P=csvcP();
 if(why==='absent'||why==='lost'||why==='late'||why==='none'){let sum=0;for(const o of D.offs){if(o.st!=='open')continue;if(o.warn){o.st='warn-absent';P.warnings++;C.st.warnings++;continue}o.st='debt';o.amt2=o.amt;sum+=o.amt;P.fines.push({id:o.id,kind:o.kind,label:o.label,kmh:o.kmh,amt:o.amt,st:'debt',why,clock:o.clock,x:o.x,y:o.y})}
  if(sum){P.debt+=sum;try{toast('המשטרה: '+(why==='lost'?'הניידת איבדה אותך':'לא היית במקום')+' — קנס '+money(sum)+' נרשם כחוב')}catch(e){}}
  if(P.fines.length>40)P.fines.splice(0,P.fines.length-40);C.st[why]++;}
 if(D.car)csvcRelease(D.car);D.ph='closed';D.why=why;D.t1=C.t;C.done.push({id:D.id,why,car:D.car&&D.car.id,offs:D.offs.map(o=>o.id+':'+o.st),resp:D.tArr!=null?+(D.tArr-D.t0).toFixed(1):null,len:+(C.t-D.t0).toFixed(1)});if(C.done.length>40)C.done.shift();
 csvcLog(D.id+' נסגרה — '+why);C.disp=null}
function csvcDispStep(dt){const C=CITYSVC,D=C.disp;if(!D)return;const cf=C.cfg,v=D.car;
 if(v&&!TRAFFIC_CARS.includes(v)){D.car=null;D.ph='find'}
 if(D.ph==='find'){if(C.t>=D.retry)csvcFind(D);if(D.ph==='find'&&C.t-D.t0>cf.arriveMax)csvcClose(D,'none');return}
 if(!v)return;
 /* a police car that does not move for 40 s while it drives (not held) — counted (QA: "אין רכב חירום שנתקע") */
 if(D.ph==='go'||D.ph==='chase'){if(Math.hypot(v.x-D.lx,v.y-D.ly)>4){D.lx=v.x;D.ly=v.y;D.still=0}else if(!(v.taxiRoute&&v.taxiRoute.hold)){D.still+=dt;
  if(D.still>40&&!D.stuckSeen){D.stuckSeen=1;C.st.stuckPol++;const c=v.c2||{},q=csvcPlayer();C.stuck=(C.stuck||[]).concat([{d:D.id,car:v.id,x:Math.round(v.x),y:Math.round(v.y),pd:Math.round(Math.hypot(q.x-v.x,q.y-v.y)),why:c.why||null,hardBy:c.hardBy||null,edge:v.edgeId,player:[Math.round(q.x),Math.round(q.y)]}]).slice(-10);csvcLog(D.id+' '+v.id+' לא זזה 40 שנ׳')}
  if(D.still>20&&D.still-dt<=20&&v.taxiRoute&&!v.taxiRoute.hold){const T=v.taxiRoute;v.taxiRoute=null;if(!csvcRoute(v,T.targetX,T.targetY,T.phase))v.taxiRoute=T}}   /* 20 s without moving — a new way to the same point */
  /* the patrol car waits in the queue behind the player's own car: the officer walks the last metres (the player stands, ≤ 30 m) */
  {const q=csvcPlayer();if(D.still>6&&q.spd<cf.catchV&&Math.hypot(q.x-v.x,q.y-v.y)<cf.walkR){csvcHold(v);const ch=D.ph==='chase';if(!ch)csvcArrStat(D);else C.st.caught++;csvcLog(D.id+' השוטר הולך ברגל אל רכב השחקן');csvcStop(D,ch);return}}}
 if(D.ph==='go'){if(!v.taxiRoute){if(!csvcRoute(v,D.x,D.y,'csvc-go')){csvcArrive(D);return}}
  if(csvcNear(D)&&csvcPlayer().spd<cf.catchV){csvcHold(v);csvcArrive(D);return}
  if(csvcP().wanted>=1){const p=csvcPlayer();if(Math.hypot(p.x-D.x,p.y-D.y)>600){D.rt+=dt;if(D.rt>cf.reroute){D.x=p.x;D.y=p.y;csvcChase(D);return}}}
  if(C.t-D.tGo>cf.arriveMax){csvcClose(D,'late')}return}
 if(D.ph==='meet'){D.mt+=dt;const p=csvcPlayer();if(csvcNear(D)&&p.spd<cf.catchV){D.kt+=dt;if(D.kt>=cf.catchS){csvcStop(D,false);return}}else D.kt=0;
  if(D.mt>cf.meetS){if(csvcP().wanted>=1&&D.ct<cf.chaseMax)csvcChase(D);else csvcClose(D,'absent')}return}
 if(D.ph==='chase'){D.ctAll=(D.ctAll||0)+dt;D.rt+=dt;const p=csvcPlayer(),d=Math.hypot(p.x-v.x,p.y-v.y);if(d<cf.chaseNear)D.ct+=dt;   /* the 60 s of the chase run while the patrol car is near (80 m); the whole chase — up to 150 s */
  if(d<cf.catchR&&p.spd<cf.catchV){D.kt+=dt;if(D.kt>=cf.catchS){C.st.caught++;csvcStop(D,true);return}}else D.kt=0;
  if(D.ct>cf.chaseMax||D.ctAll>cf.chaseAll){csvcClose(D,'lost');return}
  /* a new way only when the player moved away from the last target (150 px) and the car is not in a junction's turn — a new route drops its grant (071) */
  const moved=Math.hypot(p.x-D.tx,p.y-D.ty)>150,busy=!!(v.c2&&(v.c2.granted||v.c2.mv));
  if(!v.taxiRoute||(D.rt>=cf.reroute&&moved&&!busy)){D.rt=0;if(v.taxiRoute&&v.taxiRoute.hold){v.taxiRoute=null;v.wait=false}if(csvcRoute(v,p.x,p.y,'csvc-chase')){D.tx=p.x;D.ty=p.y}}return}
 if(D.ph==='stop'){D.sT+=dt;if(D.sT>=cf.stopS)csvcClose(D,'done')}}
function csvcStop(D,chase){const C=CITYSVC;if(D.car)csvcHold(D.car);D.ph='stop';D.sT=0;C.st.stops++;csvcLog(D.id+' עצירה'+(chase?' אחרי מרדף':''));csvcCharge(D,chase)}

{const pT=taxiServiceArrived;taxiServiceArrived=function(car){if(car&&car.csvc){try{csvcArrived(car)}catch(e){csvcErr('arr',e)}return}return pT.apply(this,arguments)}}

function csvcHeliMove(H,tx,ty,v,dt){const dx=tx-H.x,dy=ty-H.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(d<.01)return 0;if(H.z<H.roof+6)return d;const s=Math.min(d,v*dt);H.x+=dx/d*s;H.y+=dy/d*s;

function csvcHeliStep(H,dt){if(!H||!H.legs)return;const L=H.legs[H.li];if(!L){csvcHeliNext(H);return}H.lt+=dt;if(H.rot>0)H.phi+=dt*(.3+.7*H.rot);

   if(H.hold>=L.T){if(L.drop){H.drops++;H.mDrops++}if(L.fill){H.fills++;H.mFills++}csvcHeliNext(H)}}return}

  let dh=H.h0-H.h;dh=Math.atan2(Math.sin(dh),Math.cos(dh));H.h+=Math.max(-.8*dt,Math.min(.8*dt,dh));if(d<=.5){H.z=Math.max(H.roof,H.z-1.3*dt);if(H.z<=H.roof+.001&&Math.abs(dh)<.02){H.z=H.roof;H.h=H.h0;csvcHeliNext(H)}}return}

/* the way to (x, y): as taxiApproach (the public two-way roads, the shorter of the two entries of the edge), and the side of the road nearest to the place
   is worth 30 px of way for each pixel nearer — the car stops on the near kerb (and drives round the block for it), so the crew never crosses the road */
function evtApproach(car,x,y){const pub=e=>!pgRestrictedEdge(e)&&!e.future&&!e.freightOnly&&!e.oneway&&(typeof clPub!=='function'||clPub(e));let pos=null;try{pos=nearestRoadPosition(x,y,pub)}catch(err){pos=null}if(!pos||!pos.edge)return null;
 const e=byEdge[car.edgeId];if(!e)return null;const forward=car.dirSign>0?e.b:e.a,te=pos.edge,C=[];
 const side=dir=>{let m=1e4;for(let ln=0;ln<4;ln++){try{const p=trafficEdgePoint(te.id,dir,clamp(dir>0?pos.u:1-pos.u,.06,.94),ln);if(p&&isFinite(p.x))m=Math.min(m,Math.hypot(p.x-x,p.y-y))}catch(err){}}return m};   /* the outer lane of each direction */
 for(const dir of [1,-1]){const tt=dir>0?pos.u:1-pos.u;if(car.edgeId===te.id&&car.dirSign===dir&&tt>(car.t||0)+.05){C.push({nodes:[forward],entry:forward,dir,fa:true,cost:side(dir)*30});continue}
  const entry=dir>0?te.a:te.b;let nodes=[];try{nodes=shortestNodePath(forward,entry,pub)}catch(err){nodes=[]}if(!nodes.length)continue;let L=0;try{L=taxiPathPx(nodes)}catch(err){}C.push({nodes,entry,dir,fa:false,cost:L+side(dir)*30})}
 if(!C.length)return null;C.sort((a,b)=>a.cost-b.cost);const c=C[0];
 return{nodes:c.nodes,pos:0,entryNode:c.entry,finalEdgeId:te.id,finalDirSign:c.dir,finalT:taxiFinalClamp(te.id,c.dir,c.dir>0?pos.u:1-pos.u),finalActive:c.fa,targetX:x,targetY:y}}
function evtRoute(v,x,y,ph){let r=null;try{r=evtApproach(v,x,y)}catch(e){r=null}
 if(r){v.taxiRoute={...r,phase:'evt-'+ph,hold:false,arrived:false};v.plan=null;v.runKey=null;v.wait=false;v.targetSpeed=96;if(v.evt){v.evt.ph=ph;v.evt.tx=x;v.evt.ty=y}return true}
 let ok=false;try{ok=routeTaxiCar(v,x,y,'evt-'+ph)}catch(e){ok=false}if(ok){v.targetSpeed=96;if(v.evt){v.evt.ph=ph;v.evt.tx=x;v.evt.ty=y}}return ok}
function evtFreeCar(v,kind){if(!v||v.kind!==kind||v.evt||v.csvc||v.taxiRoute||v.fuelGo||v.c5||v.cl||v.clTaxi||v.c4f||v.clOff||!byEdge[v.edgeId])return false;
 try{if(CITYSVC.disp&&CITYSVC.disp.car===v)return false}catch(e){}return true}
function evtTake(e,kind,x,y,ph){const L=TRAFFIC_CARS.filter(v=>evtFreeCar(v,kind)).sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-x,a.y-y)-Math.hypot(b.x-x,b.y-y));
 for(const v of L){const ts=v.targetSpeed;v.evt={id:e.id,ts,ph,tx:x,ty:y,lights:true};if(evtRoute(v,x,y,ph)){e.car=v;e.carId=v.id;v.evt.lx=v.x;v.evt.ly=v.y;v.evt.still=0;evtLog(e.id+' '+v.id+' יוצא ('+Math.round(Math.hypot(v.x-x,v.y-y)/10)+' מ׳)');return v}v.evt=null}
 return null}
function evtHold(v){v.speed=0;v.wait=true;v.stuck=0;if(v.taxiRoute){v.taxiRoute.hold=true;v.taxiRoute.arrived=true}
 else v.taxiRoute={nodes:[],pos:0,entryNode:null,finalEdgeId:v.edgeId,finalDirSign:v.dirSign,finalT:v.t,finalActive:true,targetX:v.x,targetY:v.y,phase:'evt-hold',hold:true,arrived:true}}
function evtRelease(v){if(!v)return;const ts=v.evt&&v.evt.ts;v.evt=null;v.taxiRoute=null;v.plan=null;v.runKey=null;v.wait=false;v.hop=(v.hop||0)+3;if(ts!=null)v.targetSpeed=ts}
function evtArrived(car){const e=EVT.act.find(q=>car.evt&&q.id===car.evt.id);evtHold(car);if(!e){evtRelease(car);return}e.arr=car.evt.ph;evtLog(e.id+' '+car.id+' הגיע ('+car.evt.ph+')')}
{const pT=taxiServiceArrived;taxiServiceArrived=function(car){if(car&&car.evt){try{evtArrived(car)}catch(e){evtErr('arr',e)}return}return pT.apply(this,arguments)}}
{const pF=csvcFree;csvcFree=function(v){return !(v&&v.evt)&&pF.apply(this,arguments)}}   /* a patrol car on an event is not free for CITYSVC */
/* the car on its way: a car that has not moved 4 px for 12 s gets a new way to the same point (and again every 15 s); 60 s — counted (the QA: no emergency car stands) */
function evtCarWatch(e,dt){const v=e.car;if(!v||!v.evt)return;if(v.taxiRoute&&v.taxiRoute.hold){v.evt.still=0;v.stuck=0;return}
 if(Math.hypot(v.x-v.evt.lx,v.y-v.evt.ly)>4){v.evt.lx=v.x;v.evt.ly=v.y;v.evt.still=0;v.evt.rrAt=12;return}v.evt.still+=dt;EVT.st.stillMax=Math.max(EVT.st.stillMax,+v.evt.still.toFixed(1));
 if(v.evt.still>=(v.evt.rrAt||12)){v.evt.rrAt=v.evt.still+15;EVT.st.reroutes++;const T=v.taxiRoute;v.taxiRoute=null;if(!evtRoute(v,v.evt.tx,v.evt.ty,v.evt.ph))v.taxiRoute=T}
 if(v.evt.still>EVT.cfg.stillMax&&!v.evt.stillSeen){v.evt.stillSeen=1;EVT.st.still++;EVT.st.stuck=EVT.st.stuck.concat([{e:e.id,car:v.id,x:Math.round(v.x),y:Math.round(v.y),edge:v.edgeId,ph:v.evt.ph}]).slice(-8);evtLog(e.id+' '+v.id+' לא זז 60 שנ׳')}}
/* the people: the pedestrians of the city (the 8 walkers NPC-PED-n) — one of them falls or runs; the crews come out of their vehicles */
function evtNpcFree(n){if(!n||!/^NPC-PED-\d+$/.test(n.id)||n.evt||n.inCrosswalk||n.wait)return false;if(n.targetId){const ed=pedEdgeBetween(n.nodeId,n.targetId);if(ed&&(ed.type==='crosswalk'||ed.type==='zebra'))return false}return true}
function evtPickNpc(near,any){let L=NPC_PEDESTRIANS.filter(n=>evtNpcFree(n)&&evtOpen(n.x,n.y)&&evtFarFromOthers(n.x,n.y));if(!L.length&&any)L=NPC_PEDESTRIANS.filter(n=>evtNpcFree(n)&&!inPortZone(n.x,n.y));if(!L.length)return null;
 if(near)return L.sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-near.x,a.y-near.y)-Math.hypot(b.x-near.x,b.y-near.y))[0];return L[(Math.imul(++EVT.serial,2654435761)>>>0)%L.length]}
function evtPedNode(x,y){let best=null,bd=1e9;for(const n of PED_START_NODES){const d=Math.hypot(n.x-x,n.y-y);if(d<bd){bd=d;best=n}}return best}
function evtTakeNpc(n){const i=NPC_PEDESTRIANS.indexOf(n);if(i>=0)NPC_PEDESTRIANS.splice(i,1)}
function evtPutBack(n,x,y){const nd=evtPedNode(x,y);n.x=x;n.y=y;if(nd){n.nodeId=nd.id;n.targetId=nd.id}n.lastNode=null;n.inCrosswalk=null;n.wait=false;n.pose='idle';n.ghost=1.5;n.blockT=0;if(n.evtSpeed){n.speed=n.evtSpeed;n.evtSpeed=0}n.evt=null;if(!NPC_PEDESTRIANS.includes(n))NPC_PEDESTRIANS.push(n)}
function evtMan(asset,x,y){return{asset,x,y,dir:2,pose:'idle',vis:true}}
/* a walk of a crew member: straight when the line stays off the road; otherwise through one point on the kerb (the middle of the line, pushed off the road) */
function evtPath(A,B){if(typeof evtSegOk!=='function'||evtSegOk(A,B))return[B];const mx=(A.x+B.x)/2,my=(A.y+B.y)/2,dx=B.x-A.x,dy=B.y-A.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,nx=-dy/d,ny=dx/d;let best=null;
 for(const [ux,uy] of [[nx,ny],[-nx,-ny]]){const W=evtOff(mx,my,ux,uy);if(evtSegOk(A,W)&&evtSegOk(W,B)){const L=Math.hypot(W.x-A.x,W.y-A.y)+Math.hypot(B.x-W.x,B.y-W.y);if(!best||L<best.L)best={W,L}}}
 if(best)return[best.W,B];EVT.st.pathMiss=(EVT.st.pathMiss||0)+1;return[B]}
function evtWalk(p,tx,ty,v,dt,run){if(p.gx!==tx||p.gy!==ty){p.gx=tx;p.gy=ty;try{p.wp=evtPath({x:p.x,y:p.y},{x:tx,y:ty})}catch(e){p.wp=[{x:tx,y:ty}]}}
 const q=p.wp&&p.wp.length?p.wp[0]:{x:tx,y:ty},dx=q.x-p.x,dy=q.y-p.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
 if(d<1.5){p.x=q.x;p.y=q.y;if(p.wp&&p.wp.length>1){p.wp.shift();return false}p.pose='idle';return true}const m=Math.min(d,v*dt);p.x+=dx/d*m;p.y+=dy/d*m;p.dir=npcDir(dx,dy,p.dir);p.pose=run?'running':'walking';return false}
function evtCarLen(v){try{const sc=roadVehicleScaleFor(v.asset,v.ref),I=TurboCity.info(v.asset,{scale:sc});return I.w||50}catch(e){return 50}}
/* the road, as the test "אנשים בכביש" sees it (R-76): inside the width of an edge and not in a crossing — no person of an event ever stands there */
let EVT_RD=null;
function evtRoads(){if(EVT_RD)return EVT_RD;const RD=[],X=[];try{for(const e of EDGES){if(e.future)continue;const a=_NODE_BY_ID[e.a],b=_NODE_BY_ID[e.b];if(!a||!b)continue;const dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,L=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(L<1)continue;const h=(TYPES[e.cls]||TYPES.local).width/2;
  RD.push({id:e.id,ax:a.x,ay:a.y,ux:dx/L,uy:dy/L,L,h,x0:Math.min(a.x,b.x)-h,x1:Math.max(a.x,b.x)+h,y0:Math.min(a.y,b.y)-h,y1:Math.max(a.y,b.y)+h})}}catch(err){evtErr('roads',err)}
 try{for(const c of [...CROSSWALKS,...(typeof ZEBRA_XW!=='undefined'?ZEBRA_XW:[])]){const r=RD.find(q=>q.id===c.roadId);if(r)X.push({x:c.x,y:c.y,ux:r.ux,uy:r.uy,h:r.h})}}catch(err){}
 return EVT_RD={RD,X}}
function evtOnRoad(x,y){const {RD,X}=evtRoads();for(const r of RD){if(x<r.x0||x>r.x1||y<r.y0||y>r.y1)continue;const px=x-r.ax,py=y-r.ay,t=px*r.ux+py*r.uy,o=Math.abs(-px*r.uy+py*r.ux);
  if(t>=0&&t<=r.L&&o<r.h+1){for(const c of X){const qx=x-c.x,qy=y-c.y;if(Math.abs(qx*c.ux+qy*c.uy)<=20&&Math.abs(-qx*c.uy+qy*c.ux)<=c.h+2)return false}return true}}return false}
/* from (x, y) toward (ux, uy) — the first point off the road (+3 px onto the kerb) */
function evtOff(x,y,ux,uy){if(!evtOnRoad(x,y))return{x,y};for(let s=2;s<=120;s+=2){const qx=x+ux*s,qy=y+uy*s;if(!evtOnRoad(qx,qy))return{x:qx+ux*3,y:qy+uy*3}}return{x,y}}
function evtSegOk(a,b){const d=Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y),n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(d/4));for(let i=1;i<n;i++){if(evtOnRoad(a.x+(b.x-a.x)*i/n,a.y+(b.y-a.y)*i/n))return false}return true}
/* the doors of a stopped vehicle: along its axis (along: −.4 the rear, 0 the side, .3 the front), on the kerb toward a point — the crew steps out there */
function evtRear(v,k){const L=evtCarLen(v)*(k==null?.55:k),h=v.heading||0;return{x:v.x-Math.cos(h)*L,y:v.y-Math.sin(h)*L}}   /* the body itself (the hose) */
function evtDoor(v,tx,ty,along){const h=v.heading||0,fx=Math.cos(h),fy=Math.sin(h),px=-fy,py=fx,s=((tx-v.x)*px+(ty-v.y)*py)>=0?1:-1,L=evtCarLen(v)*(along||0);return evtOff(v.x+fx*L+px*s*6,v.y+fy*L+py*s*6,px*s,py*s)}
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- the start of an event ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function evtNew(type,x,y,label,o){const e=Object.assign({id:'EV-'+type.toUpperCase()+'-'+(++EVT.serial),type,ph:'start',t0:EVT.t,tp:EVT.t,x,y,label,zone:evtZone(x,y),car:null,carId:null,retry:0,arr:null,crew:[],ok:false},o||{});
 EVT.act.push(e);EVT.st[type].n++;try{SaveManager.log('events','start',{id:e.id,type,zone:e.zone,x:Math.round(x),y:Math.round(y)})}catch(err){}evtLog(e.id+' מתחיל — '+label);return e}

/* (1) the fire: a building (the entrance of a place) or a parked car, near a road the fire engine can reach */
const EVT_KERB=new Map();
function evtFireSites(){let P={};try{P=navPoiRegistry()}catch(e){}const S=[];for(const p of Object.values(P)){if(!p||!isFinite(p.x)||!isFinite(p.y))continue;if(!evtOpen(p.x,p.y))continue;if(Math.hypot(p.x-C4F.bayX,p.y-3125)<380)continue;
  const key=p.id+'@'+Math.round(p.x)+','+Math.round(p.y);let k=EVT_KERB.get(key);if(k===undefined){k=evtKerb(p.x,p.y);EVT_KERB.set(key,k)}if(!k||k.d>150||k.d<18)continue;S.push({x:p.x,y:p.y,label:p.label||p.id,poi:p.id,kerb:k})}return S}
function evtFireSite(near){const S=evtFireSites().filter(s=>evtFarFromOthers(s.x,s.y));if(!S.length)return null;
 const s=near?S.sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-near.x,a.y-near.y)-Math.hypot(b.x-near.x,b.y-near.y))[Math.min(S.length-1,(EVT.serial%3))]:S[(Math.imul(++EVT.serial,2246822519)>>>0)%S.length];
 /* a parked car next to the place (4 of 10) — it burns instead of the building */
 if((Math.imul(EVT.serial+7,374761393)>>>0)%10<4){let best=null,bd=1e9;try{for(const c of PARKED_CARS){if(Math.abs(c.x-s.x)>240||Math.abs(c.y-s.y)>240)continue;const d=Math.hypot(c.x-s.x,c.y-s.y);if(d<bd&&evtOpen(c.x,c.y)){const k=evtKerb(c.x,c.y);if(k&&k.d<110&&k.d>14){bd=d;best={c,k}}}}}catch(e){}
  if(best)return{x:best.c.x,y:best.c.y,label:'רכב חונה ליד '+s.label,car:best.c.id,carAsset:best.c.asset,carH:best.c.heading||0,kerb:best.k,poi:s.poi}}
 return s}
function evtStartFire(near){const s=evtFireSite(near);if(!s)return null;const e=evtNew('fire',s.x,s.y,s.label,{kind:s.car?'car':'building',parkedId:s.car||null,kerb:s.kerb,I:0,cool:0,unit:null,poi:s.poi});

/* (2) a man falls */

function evtClose(e,why){if(e.npc&&NPC_PEDESTRIANS.includes(e.npc)){if(e.npc.evtSpeed){e.npc.speed=e.npc.evtSpeed;e.npc.evtSpeed=0}e.npc.evt=null}e.why=why;e.ok=why==='done';e.t1=EVT.t;const i=EVT.act.indexOf(e);if(i>=0)EVT.act.splice(i,1);if(e.car&&e.car.evt&&e.car.evt.id===e.id)evtRelease(e.car);

 if(why==='done')EVT.st[e.type].done++;else if(EVT.st[e.type][why]!=null)EVT.st[e.type][why]++;

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- the steps ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function evtFireStep(e,dt){const F=EVT.cfg.fire;
 if(e.ph==='burn'||e.ph==='coming'||e.ph==='fight')e.I=Math.min(1,e.I+(e.ph==='fight'&&e.spray?0:dt/F.grow));
 if(e.ph==='burn'){let U=[];try{U=c4fUnits()}catch(err){}
  /* C4F: one truck out at a time (the door and its red are one, and its audit counts it) — a parked truck goes when all three are in; a truck that is out
     on a routine call (no fire — the old empty call) is sent on to the fire, from the road or from its call; one on its way back is left alone */
  const door=U.some(u=>u.ph==='out'||u.ph==='merge'||u.ph==='enter'||u.ph==='arrived'||u.ph==='in'),call=k=>({id:e.id,label:'אש — '+e.label,x:k?k.x:e.x,y:k?k.y:e.y,evt:e.id});
  if(C4F.on&&EVT.t>=e.retry){const k=e.kerb||evtKerb(e.x,e.y),u=U.filter(q=>q.ph==='park').sort((a,b)=>a.trips-b.trips||a.bay-b.bay)[0];
   if(u&&!door&&!U.some(q=>q.ph!=='park')){c4fDepart(u,call(k));u.evtId=e.id;e.unit=u;e.carId=u.id;C4F.next=Math.max(C4F.next,C4F.t+C4F.every);evtPh(e,'coming');return}
   const r=U.find(q=>(q.ph==='go'||q.ph==='scene')&&q.v&&!(q.call&&q.call.evt&&EVT.act.some(x=>x.id===q.call.evt))&&!(q.v.c2&&(q.v.c2.granted||q.v.c2.mv)));
   if(r){const v=r.v;r.call=call(k);r.ph='go';r.t0=C4F.t;r.evtId=e.id;v.taxiRoute=null;v.wait=false;v.plan=null;v.runKey=null;e.unit=r;e.carId=r.id;EVT.st.fire.redirect=(EVT.st.fire.redirect||0)+1;c4fLog(r.id+' מהקריאה הרגילה — לאש: '+e.label);evtPh(e,'coming');return}}
  e.waited=(e.waited||0)+dt;e.retry=EVT.t+2;if(EVT.t-e.t0>F.wait){EVT.st.fire.wait++;evtPh(e,'self')}return}
 const u=e.unit;
 if(e.ph==='coming'){if(!u){evtPh(e,'self');return}if(u.ph==='scene'&&u.call&&u.call.evt===e.id){const v=u.v;u.sceneT=0;const S=evtDoor(v,e.x,e.y,0),R=evtDoor(v,e.x,e.y,-.35);e.dS=S;e.dR=R;e.crew=[evtMan('PE-25',S.x,S.y),evtMan('PE-24',R.x,R.y)];
   const dx=e.x-S.x,dy=e.y-S.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,ux=dx/d,uy=dy/d,reach=Math.max(0,d-Math.min(F.hose,d*.55));e.spot=[evtOff(S.x+ux*reach,S.y+uy*reach,ux,uy),evtOff(S.x+ux*reach-uy*14,S.y+uy*reach+ux*14,ux,uy)];e.hoseAt=evtRear(v,.35);evtPh(e,'fight');return}
  if(u.ph==='back'||u.ph==='park'||u.ph==='arrived'||u.ph==='in'){evtPh(e,'self')}return}

/* ---- (2) the fuel: the stock of every connected destination (litres), the use per game day from the table of part ה (שרשרת הדלק, R25‑N‑14),
   the refinery — its production is the use of the connected ones (it rises between the fills and drops at every fill: "המלאי בבית הזיקוק עולה ויורד") ---- */
const LGW_CAP=36000;   /* מכלית סמי 165 נושאת 36,000 ליטר (חלק ה, הכמויות) */
const LGW_FUEL=[
 {id:'D3F',label:'תחנת הדלק D3',use:36000,cap:72000,tank:[4328,1806]},

function lgwFuelInit(){if(LGW.fuel)return LGW.fuel;const F={v:1,last:null,ref:Math.round(LGW_REF.cap*.6),st:{},got:{},used:{}};for(const d of LGW_FUEL){F.st[d.id]=Math.round(d.cap*(LGW_START[d.id]||.7));F.got[d.id]=0;F.used[d.id]=0}return LGW.fuel=F}
const LGW_START={D3F:.5,D6F:.55,E5F:.6,C1F:.7};   /* at the start of a new game the stocks are staggered — the first round leaves in the morning, the next ones follow the use */
function lgwOn(id){return !!(LOGI.sites&&LOGI.sites[id])}   /* a destination counts only when its site stands in the game */
function lgwFuelTick(){const F=lgwFuelInit();let m;try{m=((+gameClock().min%1440)+1440)%1440}catch(e){return}if(!Number.isFinite(m))return;if(F.last==null){F.last=m;return}
 const d=(m-F.last+1440)%1440;if(d<=0)return;F.last=m;if(d>60)return;   /* a jump of the clock (gameClockSet, a load) — no use for it */
 let prod=0;for(const q of LGW_FUEL){if(!lgwOn(q.id))continue;const u=q.use*d/1440;F.st[q.id]=Math.max(0,F.st[q.id]-u);F.used[q.id]+=u;prod+=u}

/* (3) the round: at the refinery, when the fill is done — the most urgent destinations below the line (days of stock left), up to 2 stops (D‑138: 2–3) */
function lgwPick(load){const F=lgwFuelInit(),L=[];for(const q of LGW_FUEL){if(!lgwOn(q.id))continue;const s=F.st[q.id],f=s/q.cap;L.push({id:q.id,f,days:s/q.use,room:q.cap*.97-s})}

function lgwFuelPlan(v,dt){const g=v.logi,L=g.L,W=g.work;if(g.site!==L.home){g.lgwHold=false;return false}

 if(!P.length){if(!g.lgwHold){g.lgwHold=true;LGW.stats.idle++;lgwLog(v.id+' — אין הזמנה, מחכה בעמדת המילוי')}W.done=false;W.t=W.dur;v.speed=0;v.wait=true;g.waitBy='אין הזמנה';return true}   /* waits at its bay (not "ready": the van of C5 does not hold for it) */
 if(g.lgwHold){g.lgwHold=false;W.done=true}

 try{if(isF&&W&&!was&&W.done&&v.logi.site===site){const F=lgwFuelInit();
   if(W.kind==='fill'){const l=Math.round(LGW_CAP*(1-(g.load0||0)));F.ref=Math.max(0,F.ref-l);LGW.stats.fills++;g.lgwPlanned=false;lgwLog(v.id+' מילא '+l+' ל׳ בבית הזיקוק')}
   else if(W.kind==='drain'){const q=LGW_FUEL.find(d=>d.id===site),l=Math.round(Math.min((g.lgwDrop||{})[site]||LGW_CAP,q?q.cap-F.st[site]:0));if(q){F.st[site]+=l;F.got[site]+=l;LGW.stats.drops++;LGW.stats.litres+=l;g.lgwLeft=Math.max(0,(g.lgwLeft==null?LGW_CAP:g.lgwLeft)-l);lgwLog(v.id+' פרק '+l+' ל׳ ב-'+site)}}}
  /* the gauge of the tanker: a partial drop leaves the rest in it */

  if(isF&&W&&W.kind==='fill'&&v.c5.mode==='bay')g.lgwLeft=LGW_CAP}catch(e){LGW.err=LGW.err||'fuel '+String(e&&e.message||e)}

function lgwAudit(){const out={ok:true,ways:0,poses:0,solid:[],along:[]};const SW=[];try{for(const e of PED_GRAPH.edges){if(e.type!=='sidewalk')continue;const a=PED_NODE_BY_ID[e.a],b=PED_NODE_BY_ID[e.b];if(a&&b)SW.push([a.x,a.y,b.x,b.y])}}catch(e){}

     במצלמה של הרכב (RIDE ב-065: העומק 1:1 — הידיים פוגשות את הכידון); הקסדות (G.P34X.hat): מלאה עם מגן, פתוחה, אופניים, משטרה.
   · הציור: החלקים של הרכב ושל הרוכב ממוינים יחד לפי העומק (y של העולם), נצבעים פעם אחת לקנבס, עם קו המתאר הכהה של P34 (כמו האנשים).
   · אותו צייר מצייר גם את דף העיצוב (w17_design.html — SVG בקוד), דרך הקשר SVG שמחקה את הקנבס; כאן אין שום תלות במשחק.
   API: W17K.TYPES · W17K.parts(type, o) → {items, box} (מטרי מסך) · W17K.sprite(type, o) → {cv, ox, oy, k, N, res} · W17K.lamps(type) (לאורות של C34) ·
        W17K.look(role, i) — הרוכב · W17K.dims(type) → [L, W] בפיקסלים של העולם. */
/* פריט 22 (11.11): שמונה החישוקים שונים באמת — ה"כוכב" (5) היה מצויר כמו "5 חישורים" (0), ובדוגמית של המוסך "פלדה" (4) כמו "דיסק כרום" (7).
   W17RIM — הכוכב: חמישה זוגות של חישורים דקים שנפגשים בשפה ויוצרים חלונות של כוכב, ומרכז מתכת. נקרא מ-drawRim של C34 (063) ומהדוגמית של המוסך. */
function W17RIM(g, x, y, rr) { const gr = g.createLinearGradient(x - rr, y - rr, x + rr, y + rr); gr.addColorStop(0, '#f1f4f7'); gr.addColorStop(.5, '#8c949c'); gr.addColorStop(1, '#d7dce0');
  g.fillStyle = '#262a30'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, rr, 0, 7); g.fill(); g.fillStyle = gr;
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) { const a = i / 5 * 6.2832 - Math.PI / 2, p = (b, r) => [x + Math.cos(b) * r, y + Math.sin(b) * r], A = p(a - .16, rr * .26), B = p(a - .5, rr * .93), C = p(a, rr * .62), D = p(a + .5, rr * .93), E = p(a + .16, rr * .26);
    g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(A[0], A[1]); g.lineTo(B[0], B[1]); g.lineTo(C[0], C[1]); g.lineTo(D[0], D[1]); g.lineTo(E[0], E[1]); g.closePath(); g.fill() }
  g.strokeStyle = gr; g.lineWidth = rr * .1; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, rr * .95, 0, 7); g.stroke();
  g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, rr * .27, 0, 7); g.fill(); g.fillStyle = '#2a2f35'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, rr * .1, 0, 7); g.fill() }
function W17RIM_STEEL(g, x, y, rr) { g.fillStyle = '#3c4148'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, rr, 0, 7); g.fill(); g.strokeStyle = '#5b626a'; g.lineWidth = rr * .1; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, rr * .82, 0, 7); g.stroke();
  g.fillStyle = '#23272c'; for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const a = i / 6 * 6.283; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x + Math.cos(a) * rr * .55, y + Math.sin(a) * rr * .55, rr * .1, 0, 7); g.fill() } g.fillStyle = '#9aa2aa'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, rr * .24, 0, 7); g.fill() }
function W17RIM_DISC(g, x, y, rr) { const g2 = g.createRadialGradient(x - rr * .3, y - rr * .3, 0, x, y, rr); g2.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff'); g2.addColorStop(1, '#9aa3ab'); g.fillStyle = g2; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, rr, 0, 7); g.fill(); g.fillStyle = '#5c646c'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, rr * .2, 0, 7); g.fill() }
var W17K = (function (G) {
'use strict';
const K = .6, SCALE = 1.125, PXM = 10, TAU = Math.PI * 2;
const add = (a, b) => [a[0] + b[0], a[1] + b[1], a[2] + b[2]], sub = (a, b) => [a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1], a[2] - b[2]], mul = (a, k) => [a[0] * k, a[1] * k, a[2] * k];
const dot = (a, b) => a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2], crs = (a, b) => [a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1], a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2], a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0]];
const nrm = v => { const n = Math.hypot(v[0], v[1], v[2]) || 1; return [v[0] / n, v[1] / n, v[2] / n] };
// ---- the light: the sun of C34 / P34 (up-left), the same ambient / diffuse and the same colour ramp ----
const LD = nrm([-0.42, -0.55, 0.72]), VW = nrm([0, K, 1]), HV = nrm(add(LD, VW)), AMB = .62, DIF = .38, TOPB = AMB + DIF * LD[2];
const MAT = { paint: { s: .32, p: 14 }, chrome: { s: .8, p: 26 }, metal: { s: .5, p: 18 }, plastic: { s: .25, p: 10 }, rubber: { s: .05, p: 4 }, matte: { s: 0, p: 1 }, glass: { s: .9, p: 30 }, seat: { s: .12, p: 8 }, lamp: { s: .6, p: 20, glow: .5 } };
function bri(n, m) { let b = (AMB + DIF * Math.max(0, dot(n, LD))) / TOPB; if (n[2] < 0) b *= 1 + .3 * n[2]; if (m) { if (m.s) b += m.s * Math.pow(Math.max(0, dot(n, HV)), m.p); if (m.glow) b = b * (1 - m.glow) + 1.12 * m.glow } return b }
const HEXM = new Map(); const hexC = h => { let c = HEXM.get(h); if (!c) { const n = parseInt(h.slice(1), 16); c = [n >> 16 & 255, n >> 8 & 255, n & 255]; HEXM.set(h, c) } return c };
function col(h, b) { const c = hexC(h); if (b <= 1) return `rgb(${c[0] * b + 14 * (1 - b) | 0},${c[1] * b + 17 * (1 - b) | 0},${c[2] * b + 22 * (1 - b) | 0})`; const k = Math.min(1, (b - 1) * .6); return `rgb(${c[0] + (255 - c[0]) * k | 0},${c[1] + (255 - c[1]) * k | 0},${c[2] + (255 - c[2]) * k | 0})` }
function hull(p) { if (p.length < 3) return p.slice(); p = p.slice().sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0] || a[1] - b[1]); const cr = (o, a, b) => (a[0] - o[0]) * (b[1] - o[1]) - (a[1] - o[1]) * (b[0] - o[0]);
  const lo = [], up = []; for (const q of p) { while (lo.length >= 2 && cr(lo[lo.length - 2], lo[lo.length - 1], q) <= 0) lo.pop(); lo.push(q) }
  for (let i = p.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const q = p[i]; while (up.length >= 2 && cr(up[up.length - 2], up[up.length - 1], q) <= 0) up.pop(); up.push(q) } return lo.slice(0, -1).concat(up.slice(0, -1)) }
const poly = (c, pts) => { c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]); for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) c.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]); c.closePath() };
const area2 = q => { let a = 0; for (let i = 0; i < q.length; i++) { const p = q[i], r = q[(i + 1) % q.length]; a += p[0] * r[1] - r[0] * p[1] } return a };

// ================================================================ the riders (P34): the pose and the helmets ================================================================
// look.ride = { seat (m, the top of the seat under the hip), lean, pitch, peg [forward, half spacing, z], bar [forward, half spacing, z], crank {c:[fwd, z], r, s, ang} }
// — every point relative to the rider's ground point (under the hip), in the rider's frame (f forward, l left)
const P34X = G.P34X || (G.P34X = {});
P34X.cam = act => !!act && act.k === 'ride';
P34X.pose = function (S, L, act, fr, X) {
  if (!act || act.k !== 'ride' || !L.ride) return;
  const R = L.ride, D = S.D, f = S.f, l = S.l, O = [0, 0, 0], { comb, ik, Z } = X;
  S.fU = f; S.lU = l; S.sit = true; S.ride = true;   // no twist toward the camera: the shoulders square to the bars
  const pelZ = R.seat + .07 * D.hs, lean = R.lean != null ? R.lean : .12, fU = f, lU = l;
  const pel = comb(O, f, 0, l, 0, pelZ); S.pel = pel; S.legs = [];
  for (const side of [1, -1]) {
    const hip = comb(pel, f, 0, l, side * D.hipS, 0);
    let pa = R.peg[0], ps = R.peg[1], pz = R.peg[2];
    if (R.crank) { const a = R.crank.ang + (side > 0 ? 0 : Math.PI); pa = R.crank.c[0] + Math.cos(a) * R.crank.r; pz = R.crank.c[1] + Math.sin(a) * R.crank.r; ps = R.crank.s }
    const ank = comb(O, f, pa, l, side * ps, pz + D.ankZ), bend = nrm(add(add(f, mul(Z, 1.1)), mul(l, side * (R.knee != null ? R.knee : .3))));
    const j = ik(hip, ank, D.thigh, D.shin, bend), toeA = (L.shoes && L.shoes.t === 'leather' ? .082 : .072) * D.hs;
    const toe = add(j.ank, add(mul(f, toeA), [0, 0, -D.ankZ + .028])), heel = add(j.ank, add(mul(f, -.028 * D.hs), [0, 0, -D.ankZ + .03]));
    S.legs.push({ side, hip, knee: j.knee, ank: j.ank, toe, heel, y: l[1] * side });
  }
  const tc = comb(O, fU, lean * .25, lU, 0, 0);
  S.torsoAt = z => comb(tc, fU, lean * (z - pelZ), lU, 0, 0); S.pelZ = pelZ; S.lean = lean;
  const bob = pelZ - D.hipZ, pitch = R.pitch != null ? R.pitch : -.04; S.dz = bob;
  const nb = add(S.torsoAt(D.neck0 + bob), [0, 0, D.neck0 + bob]), nt = add(S.torsoAt(D.neck1 + bob), [fU[0] * .012, fU[1] * .012, D.neck1 + bob]); S.neck = [nb, nt];
  const ef = nrm(add(mul(fU, Math.cos(pitch)), mul(Z, -Math.sin(pitch)))), ez = nrm(add(mul(Z, Math.cos(pitch)), mul(fU, Math.sin(pitch))));
  S.head = { c: add(add(S.torsoAt(D.headZ + bob), [0, 0, D.headZ + bob]), add(mul(fU, .016 * D.hs), mul(ef, .01 * D.hs))), ax: [lU, ef, ez], r: D.head };
  S.arms = [];
  for (const side of [1, -1]) {
    const sh = add(add(S.torsoAt(D.shZ + bob), [0, 0, D.shZ + bob]), add(mul(lU, side * D.armS), mul(fU, -.008)));
    const grip = comb(O, f, R.bar[0], l, side * R.bar[1], R.bar[2]), wd0 = nrm(sub(grip, sh)), wrT = sub(grip, mul(wd0, .05 * D.hs));
    const j = ik(sh, wrT, D.uarm, D.farm, nrm(add(add(mul(lU, side * .7), [0, 0, -1]), mul(fU, -.3)))), el = j.knee, wr = j.ank, wd = nrm(sub(grip, wr)), hand = add(wr, mul(wd, .052 * D.hs));
    S.arms.push({ side, sh, el, wr, hand, wd });
  }
};
// the helmets: 'moto' — full face with the visor and the chin bar; 'jet' — open face with a short peak; 'bikeh' — a bicycle shell with vents.
// hat.c the shell, hat.v the visor, hat.s a stripe (the police: blue)
P34X.hat = P34X.hat || {};

  const sh = ellipPart('hair', headD + .021, c0, H.ax, R, null, hc, M.plastic, 1); if (sh) out.push(sh);
  if (hat.s) { const st = ellipPart('hair', headD + .0212, c0, H.ax, R.map(v => v * 1.004), [{ n: el, d: -.12 * R[0] }, { n: Mu(el, -1), d: -.12 * R[0] }], hat.s, M.plastic, 1); if (st) out.push(st) }
  if (Dt(ef, [0, 1, 0]) > -.55) { const vz = hat.open ? -.05 : .02, vs = ellipPart('hair', headD + .0215, c0, H.ax, R.map(v => v * 1.008), [{ n: ef, d: .42 * R[1] }, { n: ez, d: (vz - .3) * R[2] }, { n: Mu(ez, -1), d: -.42 * R[2] }], hat.v || '#141a22', M.metal, 1); if (vs) out.push(vs) }
};
P34X.hat.jet = function (out, X) { const { H, ef, ez, el, headD, D, hat, ellipPart, MAT: M, add: A, mul: Mu, nrm: N } = X, hc = hat.c || '#22262b', R = [H.r[0] * 1.26, H.r[1] * 1.2, H.r[2] * 1.14], c0 = A(H.c, Mu(ez, .016 * D.hk));
  const sh = ellipPart('hair', headD + .021, c0, H.ax, R, [{ n: N(A(Mu(ef, -.62), Mu(ez, .78))), d: -.5 * R[2] }], hc, M.plastic, 1); if (sh) out.push(sh);
  if (hat.s) { const st = ellipPart('hair', headD + .0212, c0, H.ax, R.map(v => v * 1.004), [{ n: el, d: -.1 * R[0] }, { n: Mu(el, -1), d: -.1 * R[0] }, { n: N(A(Mu(ef, -.62), Mu(ez, .78))), d: -.5 * R[2] }], hat.s, M.plastic, 1); if (st) out.push(st) }
};
P34X.hat.bikeh = function (out, X) { const { H, ef, ez, el, headD, D, hat, lod, ellipPart, linePart, P, MAT: M, add: A, mul: Mu, nrm: N } = X, hc = hat.c || '#e8462f', R = [H.r[0] * 1.17, H.r[1] * 1.22, H.r[2] * 1.1], c0 = A(H.c, A(Mu(ez, .03 * D.hk), Mu(ef, -.008)));
  const sh = ellipPart('hair', headD + .021, c0, H.ax, R, [{ n: N(A(ez, Mu(ef, -.18))), d: .12 * R[2] }], hc, M.plastic, 1); if (sh) out.push(sh);
  if (lod >= 1) for (const s of [-.35, 0, .35]) { const pts = []; for (let i = 0; i <= 8; i++) { const a = -.9 + i * .22; pts.push(A(c0, A(A(Mu(ef, R[1] * Math.sin(a) * .99), Mu(ez, R[2] * Math.cos(a) * .99)), Mu(el, R[0] * s)))) }
    out.push(linePart('hair', headD + .0213, pts, '#1b1f24', .012 * D.hk, null)) }
};

// ================================================================ the vehicle models ================================================================
// the frame: u forward (m, from the centre of the footprint), v to the LEFT, z up. Every model: the real size (the owner R‑70 / D‑389: the dimensions of
// a real vehicle of the same kind, the shape original); the game draws it × 1.125 (D‑369).  parts — the list of solids; lamps — for C34.lights; rider —
// where the rider sits (u of the hip, v, and his ride table).
const PAL = { red: '#c8262b', blue: '#1f5aa6', black: '#22262b', white: '#eef1f3', silver: '#b9c0c7', teal: '#1f9aa6', orange: '#ee7d2d', green: '#2f7d4a', sand: '#c9a46a', yellow: '#f2c230', olive: '#5d6b3a', navy: '#1b2b45', grey: '#6b737b' };
const C = { tyre: '#1a1d21', rim: '#b9c0c7', silver: '#b9c0c7', dark: '#2a2f35', black: '#16191d', seat: '#24272c', chrome: '#d7dce0', alu: '#a8b0b8', glass: '#9fc7dc', lampW: '#f4f1df', lampR: '#c81e1e', lampA: '#f39a2b', rubber: '#2b2f33' };
// solids: prism (a side profile [u, z, half width] extruded across v), box, tube (a polyline with a radius), wheel, blob (an ellipsoid), disc
const prism = (pts, o) => Object.assign({ k: 'prism', pts }, o);
const box = (u0, u1, v0, v1, z0, z1, o) => Object.assign({ k: 'box', u0, u1, v0, v1, z0, z1 }, o);
const tube = (pts, r, o) => Object.assign({ k: 'tube', pts, r }, o);
const wheel = (u, r, w, o) => Object.assign({ k: 'wheel', u, r, w, v: 0 }, o);
const blob = (c, rad, o) => Object.assign({ k: 'blob', c, rad }, o);
const disc = (c, n, r, o) => Object.assign({ k: 'disc', c, n, r }, o);   // a flat round thing facing n (a lamp, a mirror)
// ---- the doors (the owner 11.11 13:40: "the doors are part of the model itself, also in the new vehicles"): one field per model, the door drawn from it at a
// state 0 … 1 (0 shut, 1 open — the doors' agent drives the state).  A door: { id, side 'L' | 'R' (the sides; L = +v) | 'B' (the back) | 'T' (a lid on top),
// hinge 'front' | 'rear' | 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right', type 'regular' | 'sliding' | 'rear' | 'double', at [u, v, z] (the closed door's corner on the
// hinge, at its foot), w (m, from the hinge), h (m, up — for a lid: across), angle (°, fully open), thick (m), col (else the body's), inner (the inside) }.
// The two-wheelers and the ATV have none (doors: []).
function doorQuad(D) { const [u, v, z] = D.at, w = D.w, h = D.h, sg = D.hinge === 'rear' || D.hinge === 'right' ? 1 : -1;
  if (D.side === 'L' || D.side === 'R') { const u1 = D.hinge === 'rear' ? u + w : u - w; return { q: [[u, v, z], [u1, v, z], [u1, v, z + h], [u, v, z + h]], axis: [[u, v, z], [u, v, z + h]], out: [0, D.side === 'L' ? 1 : -1, 0], slide: [D.hinge === 'rear' ? 1 : -1, 0, 0] } }
  if (D.side === 'B') { if (D.hinge === 'top' || D.hinge === 'bottom') { const zb = D.hinge === 'top' ? z + h : z; return { q: [[u, v, z], [u, v - w, z], [u, v - w, z + h], [u, v, z + h]], axis: [[u, v, zb], [u, v - w, zb]], out: [-1, 0, 0], lift: D.hinge === 'top' ? 1 : -1 } }
    const v1 = D.hinge === 'left' ? v - w : v + w; return { q: [[u, v, z], [u, v1, z], [u, v1, z + h], [u, v, z + h]], axis: [[u, v, z], [u, v, z + h]], out: [-1, 0, 0] } }
  /* T: a lid on top, hinged at its rear edge (u), w forward, h across from v toward −v */
  return { q: [[u, v, z], [u + w, v, z], [u + w, v - h, z], [u, v - h, z]], axis: [[u, v, z], [u, v - h, z]], out: [0, 0, 1], lid: 1 } }
function rotAbout(p, a, b, ang) { const k = nrm(sub(b, a)), r = sub(p, a), c = Math.cos(ang), s_ = Math.sin(ang), kr = crs(k, r), kd = dot(k, r); return add(a, add(add(mul(r, c), mul(kr, s_)), mul(k, kd * (1 - c)))) }
// the solids of one door at state t: a slab (the panel and its thickness), turned on its hinge (or slid along the body)
function doorSolids(D, t, bodyCol) { t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, +t || 0)); const G = doorQuad(D), th = D.thick || .05, col = D.col || bodyCol, inner = D.inner || '#3a3f45', out = [];
  const leaves = D.type === 'double' ? [Object.assign({}, D, { type: 'regular', w: D.w / 2 }), Object.assign({}, D, { type: 'regular', w: D.w / 2, hinge: D.hinge === 'left' ? 'right' : D.hinge === 'right' ? 'left' : D.hinge === 'front' ? 'rear' : 'front', at: D.side === 'B' ? [D.at[0], D.hinge === 'left' ? D.at[1] - D.w : D.at[1] + D.w, D.at[2]] : [D.hinge === 'rear' ? D.at[0] + D.w : D.at[0] - D.w, D.at[1], D.at[2]] })] : [D];
  for (const L of leaves) { const g = L === D ? G : doorQuad(L); let q = g.q.map(p => p.slice()); const n0 = (() => { const n = nrm(crs(sub(q[1], q[0]), sub(q[3], q[0]))); return dot(n, g.out) >= 0 ? n : mul(n, -1) })(); let nOut = n0;
    if (L.type === 'sliding') { const d = t * L.w * .92, o2 = mul(g.out, .06 * Math.min(1, t * 4)); q = q.map(p => add(add(p, mul(g.slide || [-1, 0, 0], d)), o2)) }
    else if (t > 0) { const ang = t * (L.angle || 70) * Math.PI / 180;
      // the sign that swings the free edge outward (or up, for a lid / a hatch)
      const test = s2 => { const m = rotAbout(q[1], g.axis[0], g.axis[1], s2 * .3); return dot(sub(m, q[1]), g.out) + (g.lid ? m[2] - q[1][2] : 0) + (g.lift ? g.lift * (m[2] - q[1][2]) : 0) }, sg = test(1) >= test(-1) ? 1 : -1;
      const tip = rotAbout(add(q[0], n0), g.axis[0], g.axis[1], sg * ang); q = q.map(p => rotAbout(p, g.axis[0], g.axis[1], sg * ang)); nOut = nrm(sub(tip, q[0])) }   // the outward side turns with the door
    const qb = q.map(p => sub(p, mul(nOut, th)));
    out.push({ k: 'slab', q, qb, n: nOut, col, inner, mat: MAT.paint, door: L.id }) }

// ---- the riders' looks (men only): the helmet by the vehicle, the clothes by the role ----

// ================================================================ the solids → the pieces of the picture ================================================================
// a piece: { d (the depth: the world y, toward the camera), pts (screen metres, for the box), paint(c) }.  P(p): the cars' camera ×1.125.
function frame(h, ox, oy) { const cs = Math.cos(h), sn = Math.sin(h);
  const W = p => [ox + p[0] * cs + p[1] * sn, oy + p[0] * sn - p[1] * cs, p[2]];   // vehicle (u, v left, z) → world (x, y south) around the ground point
  const Pj = w => [w[0] * SCALE, (w[1] - K * w[2]) * SCALE], WN = n => [n[0] * cs + n[1] * sn, n[0] * sn - n[1] * cs, n[2]];
  return { cs, sn, W, Pj, P: p => Pj(W(p)), WN, y: p => W(p)[1] } }
function shadeFill(c, pts, hexc, n, mat, F, alpha) { c.beginPath(); poly(c, pts); const b = bri(nrm(F.WN(n)), mat); c.fillStyle = col(hexc, b); if (alpha != null) { const a0 = c.globalAlpha; c.globalAlpha = a0 * alpha; c.fill(); c.globalAlpha = a0 } else c.fill() }
// the prism: the profile [u, z, half width] at v (the centre, default 0); the two side faces and the strips; visible = facing the camera (the projected winding)
function prismPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias) { const v0 = s.v || 0, Q = s.pts, n = Q.length, A = Q.map(q => [q[0], v0 + q[2], q[1]]), B = Q.map(q => [q[0], v0 - q[2], q[1]]);
  const PA = A.map(F.P), PB = B.map(F.P), faces = [];
  // the side faces: +v (left) and −v (right); a profile given anticlockwise in (u, z) faces left on A
  const ccw = area2(Q.map(q => [q[0], q[1]])) > 0;
  faces.push({ q: PA, n: [0, 1, 0] }, { q: PB, n: [0, -1, 0] });
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const j = (i + 1) % n, e = [Q[j][0] - Q[i][0], 0, Q[j][1] - Q[i][1]], nn = nrm(ccw ? [e[2], 0, -e[0]] : [-e[2], 0, e[0]]);   // the outward normal of the strip
    faces.push({ q: [PA[i], PA[j], PB[j], PB[i]], n: nn, strip: 1 }) }
  const vis = faces.filter(f => facesCam(f.n, F));
  const cy = F.y([Q.reduce((a, q) => a + q[0], 0) / n, v0, Q.reduce((a, q) => a + q[1], 0) / n]);
  out.push({ d: cy + bias, pts: PA.concat(PB), paint: c => { for (const f of vis) shadeFill(c, f.q, s.col, f.n, s.mat, F, s.alpha);
      if (s.stripe && lod < 2) { const [sc, z0, z1] = s.stripe; for (const f of vis) { if (f.strip) continue; c.save(); c.beginPath(); poly(c, f.q); c.clip();
          const u0 = Math.min(...Q.map(q => q[0])) - .05, u1 = Math.max(...Q.map(q => q[0])) + .05, vv = f.n[1] > 0 ? v0 + Math.max(...Q.map(q => q[2])) : v0 - Math.max(...Q.map(q => q[2]));
          poly(c, [F.P([u0, vv, z0]), F.P([u1, vv, z0]), F.P([u1, vv, z1]), F.P([u0, vv, z1])]); c.fillStyle = col(sc, bri(nrm(F.WN(f.n)), MAT.paint)); c.fill(); c.restore() } }
      if (s.grille && lod < 2) { const u = Q[Q.length - 2][0] + .005; for (let k = -3; k <= 3; k++) { const vv = v0 + k * .1; c.beginPath(); const a = F.P([u, vv, .66]), b = F.P([u, vv, .98]); c.moveTo(a[0], a[1]); c.lineTo(b[0], b[1]); c.lineWidth = .035 * SCALE; c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(10,12,14,.55)'; c.stroke() } }
      c.lineJoin = 'round'; c.lineWidth = .006 * SCALE; c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(8,10,13,.28)'; for (const f of vis) { c.beginPath(); poly(c, f.q); c.stroke() } } }) }
// a face is seen when its world normal points toward the viewer: the cars' camera looks along (0, K, 1) (screen = x, y − K·z)
function facesCam(n, F) { const w = nrm(F.WN(n)); return w[1] * K + w[2] > 1e-3 }
function boxPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias) { const P = [], q = (u, v, z) => F.P([u, v, z]), { u0, u1, v0, v1, z0, z1 } = s, faces = [
    { q: [q(u1, v0, z0), q(u1, v1, z0), q(u1, v1, z1), q(u1, v0, z1)], n: [1, 0, 0] }, { q: [q(u0, v1, z0), q(u0, v0, z0), q(u0, v0, z1), q(u0, v1, z1)], n: [-1, 0, 0] },
    { q: [q(u1, v1, z0), q(u0, v1, z0), q(u0, v1, z1), q(u1, v1, z1)], n: [0, 1, 0] }, { q: [q(u0, v0, z0), q(u1, v0, z0), q(u1, v0, z1), q(u0, v0, z1)], n: [0, -1, 0] },
    { q: [q(u0, v0, z1), q(u1, v0, z1), q(u1, v1, z1), q(u0, v1, z1)], n: [0, 0, 1] }];
  const vis = faces.filter(f => facesCam(f.n, F));
  const cy = F.y([(u0 + u1) / 2, (v0 + v1) / 2, (z0 + z1) / 2]);
  out.push({ d: cy + bias, pts: faces.flatMap(f => f.q), paint: c => { for (const f of vis) { shadeFill(c, f.q, s.col, f.n, s.mat, F, s.alpha);
      if (s.logo && lod < 2 && f.n[2] === 0) { const ctr = [0, 0]; for (const p of f.q) { ctr[0] += p[0] / 4; ctr[1] += p[1] / 4 } const a = f.q[0], b = f.q[1], e = f.q[3], ax = [(b[0] - a[0]) / 2, (b[1] - a[1]) / 2], az = [(e[0] - a[0]) / 2, (e[1] - a[1]) / 2];
        const at = (x, y) => [ctr[0] + ax[0] * x + az[0] * y, ctr[1] + ax[1] * x + az[1] * y]; c.fillStyle = s.logo; poly(c, [at(-.5, -.25), at(.1, -.25), at(.1, -.5), at(.6, 0), at(.1, .5), at(.1, .25), at(-.5, .25)]); c.fill() }
      if (s.stripe && f.n[2] === 0) { const [sc, a0, a1] = s.stripe, a = f.q[0], b = f.q[1], cc = f.q[2], d = f.q[3], L = (p, r, t) => [p[0] + (r[0] - p[0]) * t, p[1] + (r[1] - p[1]) * t];
        const t0 = (a0 - 0) / 1, t1 = a1; c.fillStyle = col(sc, bri(nrm(F.WN(f.n)), MAT.paint)); const zr = z => (z - z0) / (z1 - z0), r0 = zr(z0 + (z1 - z0) * a0), r1 = zr(z0 + (z1 - z0) * a1); poly(c, [L(a, d, r0), L(b, cc, r0), L(b, cc, r1), L(a, d, r1)]); c.fill();
        if (s.stripe2) { const [s2, b0, b1] = s.stripe2; c.fillStyle = col(s2, bri(nrm(F.WN(f.n)), MAT.paint)); poly(c, [L(a, d, b0), L(b, cc, b0), L(b, cc, b1), L(a, d, b1)]); c.fill() } }
      if (s.lightbar && f.n[2] === 0) { const a = f.q[0], b = f.q[1], cc = f.q[2], d = f.q[3], L = (p, r, t) => [p[0] + (r[0] - p[0]) * t, p[1] + (r[1] - p[1]) * t];
        c.fillStyle = '#2f6fff'; poly(c, [L(a, d, .25), L(L(a, b, .48), L(d, cc, .48), .25), L(L(a, b, .48), L(d, cc, .48), .85), L(a, d, .85)]); c.fill(); c.fillStyle = '#ff2a2a'; poly(c, [L(L(a, b, .52), L(d, cc, .52), .25), L(b, cc, .25), L(b, cc, .85), L(L(a, b, .52), L(d, cc, .52), .85)]); c.fill() } }
      c.lineJoin = 'round'; c.lineWidth = .006 * SCALE; c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(8,10,13,.3)'; for (const f of vis) { c.beginPath(); poly(c, f.q); c.stroke() } } }) }
function tubePieces(s, F, lod, out, bias) { const pts = s.pts.map(F.P), r = s.r * SCALE, mid = s.pts[Math.floor(s.pts.length / 2)], cy = F.y(mid);
  const dir = nrm(sub(s.pts[s.pts.length - 1], s.pts[0])), sideN = nrm(crs(dir, [0, 0, 1])), nTop = nrm(add([0, 0, 1], mul(sideN, .2)));
  out.push({ d: cy + bias, pts: pts.flatMap(p => [[p[0] - r, p[1] - r], [p[0] + r, p[1] + r]]), paint: c => { c.lineCap = 'round'; c.lineJoin = 'round';
    const line = (w, st) => { c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]); for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) c.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]); c.lineWidth = w; c.strokeStyle = st; c.stroke() };
    line(2 * r + .008 * SCALE, 'rgba(8,10,13,.45)'); line(2 * r, col(s.col, bri(nrm(F.WN(nTop)), s.mat) * .86));
    if (lod < 2 && r * 2 > .014) { c.save(); c.translate(-r * .32, -r * .38); line(r * .7, col(s.col, bri(nrm(F.WN(nTop)), s.mat) * 1.12)); c.restore() } } }) }
// the wheel: a disc in the (u, z) plane at v (axis 'v'), or in the (v, z) plane (axis 'u': the spare on the tail gate); the tyre's tread band, the faces, the rim, the spokes
function wheelPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias) { const n = 28, axU = s.axis === 'u', zc = s.z0 != null ? s.z0 : s.r, cu = s.u, cv = s.v || 0;
  const at = (a, rr, dv) => axU ? [cu + dv, cv + Math.cos(a) * rr, zc + Math.sin(a) * rr] : [cu + Math.cos(a) * rr, cv + dv, zc + Math.sin(a) * rr];
  const hw = s.w / 2, ringO = [], ringI = [], nAx = axU ? [1, 0, 0] : [0, 1, 0];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = i / n * TAU; ringO.push(F.P(at(a, s.r, hw))); ringI.push(F.P(at(a, s.r, -hw))) }
  const w0 = nrm(F.WN(nAx)), front = (w0[1] * K + w0[2]) >= 0 ? 1 : -1;   // the face toward the camera: +axis or −axis
  const faceD = front * hw, cy = F.y([cu, cv, zc]);
  out.push({ d: cy + bias, pts: ringO.concat(ringI), paint: c => {
    c.fillStyle = col(s.tyre, .8); poly(c, hull(ringO.concat(ringI))); c.fill();
    if (s.tread && lod < 2) { c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.45)'; c.lineWidth = .02 * SCALE; for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 2) { const a = i / n * TAU, p = F.P(at(a, s.r * 1.0, -hw * .9)), q = F.P(at(a, s.r * 1.0, hw * .9)); c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(p[0], p[1]); c.lineTo(q[0], q[1]); c.stroke() } }
    const face = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) face.push(F.P(at(i / n * TAU, s.r * .97, faceD)));
    c.fillStyle = col(s.tyre, bri(mul(w0, front), MAT.rubber) * .95); poly(c, face); c.fill();

function blobPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias) { const pts = []; for (let i = 0; i <= 6; i++) { const ph = -Math.PI / 2 + Math.PI * i / 6; for (let j = 0; j < 12; j++) { const th = j / 12 * TAU; pts.push(F.P([s.c[0] + s.rad[0] * Math.cos(ph) * Math.cos(th), s.c[1] + s.rad[1] * Math.cos(ph) * Math.sin(th), s.c[2] + s.rad[2] * Math.sin(ph)])) } }

function slabPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias) { const A = s.q.map(F.P), B = s.qb.map(F.P), faces = [{ q: A, n: s.n, c: s.col }, { q: B.slice().reverse(), n: mul(s.n, -1), c: s.inner }];

  out.push({ d: cy + bias, pts: A.concat(B), paint: c => { for (const f of faces) { if (!facesCam(f.n, F)) continue; shadeFill(c, f.q, f.c, f.n, s.mat, F) }
    c.lineJoin = 'round'; c.lineWidth = .006 * SCALE; c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(8,10,13,.34)'; c.beginPath(); poly(c, A); c.stroke() } }) }
function discPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias) { const nn = nrm(s.n), e1 = nrm(Math.abs(nn[2]) > .9 ? crs(nn, [1, 0, 0]) : crs(nn, [0, 0, 1])), e2 = crs(nn, e1), pts = [];

function parts(type, o) {

    else if (s.k === 'slab') slabPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias); else if (s.k === 'wheel') wheelPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias); else if (s.k === 'blob') blobPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias); else if (s.k === 'disc') { if (lod < 2 || s.r > .03) discPieces(s, F, lod, out, bias) } }
  let riderN = 0;

    const ru = R.u || 0, rv = R.v || 0, sx = (ru * F.cs + rv * F.sn) * SCALE, sy = (ru * F.sn - rv * F.cs) * SCALE, dy = ru * F.sn - rv * F.cs;
    const A = G.P34.parts(lk, { k: 'ride' }, h / (Math.PI / 4), 0, !!o.small, o.plod != null ? o.plod : 2).parts;
    for (const p of A) { if (p.erase) continue; riderN++; out.push({ d: p.d + dy, pts: p.pts.map(q => [q[0] + sx, q[1] + sy]), p34: p, paint: c => { c.save(); c.translate(sx, sy); p.paint(c); if (p.ol && o.olW) ol34(c, p, o.olW); c.restore() } }) } }

  // the ground shadow: the footprint pushed toward the lower right (the sun up-left) — like the cars'

}
